item.title: Version 0.2.9
item.description:
Bouclier.ai v0.2.9

Added

  • Version number shown in the bottom-right of the menubar popover, so you can see at a glance which build you're running without opening Settings → About. Clickable to trigger a manual update check when Sparkle is ready.
